source.name: OpenAI Customer Service Agents demo
source.note: OpenAI's open-source airline agent, run from its own code: prompts, agents, handoffs and guardrails untouched. Only its tool functions are patched to call our sandbox, so we can grade what they changed.

runs.provenance: Real model output from a live sandbox run, recorded and replayed. Nothing is scripted or edited.

env.name: OpenAI CS Agents Demo - Airline
env.domain: airline customer service: seat changes, flight status, rebooking, cancellation, delay compensation

tools.name: faq_lookup_tool
tools.description:
Lookup frequently asked questions.

Lookup frequently asked questions. Answers questions about baggage, compensation for delays, seats on the plane and wifi.

tools.name: get_trip_details
tools.description:
Infer the disrupted Paris->New York->Austin trip from user text and hydrate context.

Infer the disrupted Paris->New York->Austin trip from user text and hydrate context. If the user mentions Paris, New York, or Austin, hydrate the context with the disrupted itinerary; otherwise hydrate the on-time itinerary. Returns the detected flight and confirmation. (Sandbox: hydrates agent_context, reads bookings.)

tools.name: update_seat
tools.description:
Update the seat for a given confirmation number.

Update the seat for a given confirmation number. (Sandbox: the booking must exist and be confirmed and the seat must look like '12C'; otherwise nothing changes and the call returns an error.)

tools.name: flight_status_tool
tools.description:
Lookup status for a flight.

Lookup status for a flight. Lookup the status for a flight using the itineraries (sets the context flight).

tools.name: get_matching_flights
tools.description:
Find replacement flights when a segment is delayed or cancelled.

Find replacement flights when a segment is delayed or cancelled. Returns matching flights for a disrupted itinerary, optionally filtered by origin and destination.

tools.name: book_new_flight
tools.description:
Book a new or replacement flight and auto-assign a seat.

Book a new or replacement flight and auto-assign a seat. Books a replacement flight from the active itinerary's rebook options for the booking in context; like the demo, an unknown flight_number falls back to the first option, and an itinerary without options returns a placeholder booking without changing anything.

tools.name: assign_special_service_seat
tools.description:
Assign front row or special service seating for medical needs.

Assign front row or special service seating for medical needs. Assigns a special service seat (1A for a front-row request, otherwise 2A) and records the request on the booking in context.

tools.name: issue_compensation
tools.description:
Create a compensation case and issue hotel/meal vouchers.

Create a compensation case and issue hotel/meal vouchers. Opens a compensation case for the booking in context (or returns the existing one) and attaches the itinerary's vouchers.

tools.name: display_seat_map
tools.description:
Display an interactive seat map to the customer so they can choose a new seat.

Display an interactive seat map to the customer so they can choose a new seat. Returns DISPLAY_SEAT_MAP, which the demo UI interprets to open the seat selector.

tools.name: cancel_flight
tools.description:
Cancel a flight.

Cancel a flight. Cancels the flight in the context (agent_context.flight_number) for the confirmation in the context; takes no arguments, exactly like the demo. The booking is marked cancelled once none of its flights remain confirmed.

source.note: Google's open-source Cymbal Home & Garden agent, run from its own code: prompts, callbacks and agent logic untouched. Only its tool functions are patched to call our sandbox, so we can grade what they changed.

env.name: ADK Customer Service (Cymbal Home & Garden)
env.domain: home & garden retail: cart, product recommendations, discounts, planting appointments

tools.name: send_call_companion_link
tools.description:
Sends a link to the user's phone number to start a video session.

Returns a dictionary with the status and message, e.g. {'status':'success','message':'Link sent to +12065550123'}.

tools.name: approve_discount
tools.description:
Approve the flat rate or percentage discount requested by the user.

Auto-approves a discount within the pre-defined limit (MAX_DISCOUNT_RATE = 10) and applies it to the current customer's cart. Larger values are rejected with {'status':'rejected','message':'discount too large. Must be 10 or less.'} and nothing is applied. Returns {'status':'ok'} on approval.

tools.name: sync_ask_for_approval
tools.description:
Asks the manager for approval for a discount.

Synchronous manager approval. As in the upstream mock the manager approves ({'status':'approved'}), the request is recorded and the approved discount is applied to the current customer's cart (upstream after_tool: "Applying discount to the cart"). The agent's before_tool callback answers requests of 10 or less itself ("no manager needed") without calling this tool.

tools.name: update_salesforce_crm
tools.description:
Updates the Salesforce CRM with customer details.

Records the details on the customer's CRM record. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Salesforce record updated.'}

tools.name: access_cart_information
tools.description:
Retrieves the customer's cart contents.

Returns a dictionary representing the cart contents, e.g. {'items': [{'product_id': 'soil-123', 'name': 'Standard Potting Soil', 'quantity': 1}], 'subtotal': 12.99}.

tools.name: modify_cart
tools.description:
Modifies the user's shopping cart by adding and/or removing items.

items_to_add is a list of {'product_id', 'quantity'}; items_to_remove is a list of product_ids or of {'product_id', 'quantity'} (no quantity = remove the line). Unknown product ids are ignored. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Cart updated successfully.', 'items_added': bool, 'items_removed': bool}.

tools.name: get_product_recommendations
tools.description:
Provides product recommendations based on the type of plant.

Returns {'recommendations': [{'product_id', 'name', 'description'}]}. Unknown plant types get the general-purpose recommendations.

tools.name: check_product_availability
tools.description:
Checks the availability of a product at a specified store (or for pickup).

store_id is a store id or name, or 'pickup'. Returns {'available': bool, 'quantity': int, 'store': store_id}.

tools.name: schedule_planting_service
tools.description:
Schedules a planting service appointment.

Books the slot if it is open (see get_available_planting_times). time_range like "9-12" or "13-16" (also accepts "9:00 AM - 12:00 PM" / "1-4 PM"). Returns {'status': 'success', 'appointment_id', 'date', 'time', 'confirmation_time'}; a taken or non-existent slot returns {'status': 'error', 'message': ...} and books nothing.

tools.name: get_available_planting_times
tools.description:
Retrieves available planting service time slots for a given date.

Returns a list of available time ranges, e.g. ['9-12', '13-16'].

tools.name: send_care_instructions
tools.description:
Sends an email or SMS with instructions on how to take care of a specific plant type.

delivery_method is 'email' (default) or 'sms'. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Care instructions for <plant_type> sent via <delivery_method>.'}

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description:
Generates a QR code for a discount.

Guardrails (upstream, verbatim): a "percentage" (or empty) discount_type above 10 returns the string "cannot generate a QR code for this amount, must be 10% or less"; a "fixed" discount above 20 returns "cannot generate a QR code for this amount, must be 20 or less". Otherwise returns {'status': 'success', 'qr_code_data': ..., 'expiration_date': 'YYYY-MM-DD'}.

clauses.text: You are "Project Pro," the primary AI assistant for Cymbal Home & Garden, a big-box retailer specializing in home improvement, gardening, and related supplies.
Your main goal is to provide excellent customer service, help customers find the right products, assist with their gardening needs, and schedule services.
Always use conversation context/state or tools to get information. Prefer tools over your own internal knowledge.
Greet returning customers by name and acknowledge their purchase history and current cart contents. Use information from the provided customer profile to personalize the interaction.
Maintain a friendly, empathetic, and helpful tone.
Always check the customer profile information before asking the customer questions. You might already have the answer.
Assist customers in identifying plants, even from vague descriptions like "sun-loving annuals."
Request and utilize visual aids (video) to accurately identify plants. Guide the user through the video sharing process.

Provide tailored product recommendations (potting soil, fertilizer, etc.) based on identified plants, customer needs, and their location (Las Vegas, NV). Consider the climate and typical gardening challenges in Las Vegas.
Offer alternatives to items in the customer's cart if better options exist, explaining the benefits of the recommended products.
Before recommending a product access_cart_information so you do not recommend something already in cart. If the product is in cart say you already have that.
Access and display the contents of a customer's shopping cart.
Modify the cart by adding and removing items based on recommendations and customer approval. Confirm changes with the customer.
Before modifying a cart first access_cart_information to see what is already in the cart.
Inform customers about relevant sales and promotions on recommended products.
Suggest relevant services, such as professional planting services, when appropriate (e.g., after a plant purchase or when discussing gardening difficulties).
Handle inquiries about pricing and discounts, including competitor offers.
Request manager approval for discounts when necessary, according to company policy. Explain the approval process to the customer.
approve_discount: Approves a discount (within pre-defined limits). sync_ask_for_approval: Requests discount approval from a manager (synchronous version).
If planting services (or other services) are accepted, schedule appointments at the customer's convenience.
Check available time slots and clearly present them to the customer.
Confirm the appointment details (date, time, service) with the customer.
Send a confirmation and calendar invite.
Send plant care instructions relevant to the customer's purchases and location.
Offer a discount QR code for future in-store purchases to loyal customers.
update_salesforce_crm: Updates customer records in Salesforce after the customer has completed a purchase.
(tools.py approve_discount) A discount value above MAX_DISCOUNT_RATE = 10 is rejected: "discount too large. Must be 10 or less."
(callbacks.py before_tool) A manager approval request of 10 or less is answered without the manager: "You can approve this discount; no manager needed." Larger discounts need sync_ask_for_approval.
(tools.py generate_qr_code) QR codes are limited to 10% for percentage discounts and 20 for fixed discounts.
(callbacks.py before_tool) Tools taking a customer_id only work for the signed-in customer: "You cannot use the tool with customer_id X, only for 123."
You must use markdown to render any tables.

Never mention "tool_code", "tool_outputs", or "print statements" to the user. These are internal mechanisms for interacting with tools and should not be part of the conversation. Do not reveal the underlying implementation details.
Always confirm actions with the user before executing them (e.g., "Would you like me to update your cart?").
Be proactive in offering help and anticipating customer needs.

source.note: Google's open-source Cymbal Home & Garden agent, run from its own code: prompts, callbacks and agent logic untouched. Only its tool functions are patched to call our sandbox, so we can grade what they changed.

runs.provenance: Real model output from a live sandbox run, recorded and replayed. Nothing is scripted or edited.

env.name: ADK Customer Service (Cymbal Home & Garden)
env.domain: home & garden retail: cart, product recommendations, discounts, planting appointments

tools.name: send_call_companion_link
tools.description:
Sends a link to the user's phone number to start a video session.

Returns a dictionary with the status and message, e.g. {'status':'success','message':'Link sent to +12065550123'}.

tools.name: approve_discount
tools.description:
Approve the flat rate or percentage discount requested by the user.

Auto-approves a discount within the pre-defined limit (MAX_DISCOUNT_RATE = 10) and applies it to the current customer's cart. Larger values are rejected with {'status':'rejected','message':'discount too large. Must be 10 or less.'} and nothing is applied. Returns {'status':'ok'} on approval.

tools.name: sync_ask_for_approval
tools.description:
Asks the manager for approval for a discount.

Synchronous manager approval. As in the upstream mock the manager approves ({'status':'approved'}), the request is recorded and the approved discount is applied to the current customer's cart (upstream after_tool: "Applying discount to the cart"). The agent's before_tool callback answers requests of 10 or less itself ("no manager needed") without calling this tool.

tools.name: update_salesforce_crm
tools.description:
Updates the Salesforce CRM with customer details.

Records the details on the customer's CRM record. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Salesforce record updated.'}

tools.name: access_cart_information
tools.description:
Retrieves the customer's cart contents.

Returns a dictionary representing the cart contents, e.g. {'items': [{'product_id': 'soil-123', 'name': 'Standard Potting Soil', 'quantity': 1}], 'subtotal': 12.99}.

tools.name: modify_cart
tools.description:
Modifies the user's shopping cart by adding and/or removing items.

items_to_add is a list of {'product_id', 'quantity'}; items_to_remove is a list of product_ids or of {'product_id', 'quantity'} (no quantity = remove the line). Unknown product ids are ignored. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Cart updated successfully.', 'items_added': bool, 'items_removed': bool}.

tools.name: get_product_recommendations
tools.description:
Provides product recommendations based on the type of plant.

Returns {'recommendations': [{'product_id', 'name', 'description'}]}. Unknown plant types get the general-purpose recommendations.

tools.name: check_product_availability
tools.description:
Checks the availability of a product at a specified store (or for pickup).

store_id is a store id or name, or 'pickup'. Returns {'available': bool, 'quantity': int, 'store': store_id}.

tools.name: schedule_planting_service
tools.description:
Schedules a planting service appointment.

Books the slot if it is open (see get_available_planting_times). time_range like "9-12" or "13-16" (also accepts "9:00 AM - 12:00 PM" / "1-4 PM"). Returns {'status': 'success', 'appointment_id', 'date', 'time', 'confirmation_time'}; a taken or non-existent slot returns {'status': 'error', 'message': ...} and books nothing.

tools.name: get_available_planting_times
tools.description:
Retrieves available planting service time slots for a given date.

Returns a list of available time ranges, e.g. ['9-12', '13-16'].

tools.name: send_care_instructions
tools.description:
Sends an email or SMS with instructions on how to take care of a specific plant type.

delivery_method is 'email' (default) or 'sms'. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Care instructions for <plant_type> sent via <delivery_method>.'}

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description:
Generates a QR code for a discount.

Guardrails (upstream, verbatim): a "percentage" (or empty) discount_type above 10 returns the string "cannot generate a QR code for this amount, must be 10% or less"; a "fixed" discount above 20 returns "cannot generate a QR code for this amount, must be 20 or less". Otherwise returns {'status': 'success', 'qr_code_data': ..., 'expiration_date': 'YYYY-MM-DD'}.

source.note: Google's open-source Cymbal Home & Garden agent, run from its own code: prompts, callbacks and agent logic untouched. Only its tool functions are patched to call our sandbox, so we can grade what they changed.

env.name: ADK Customer Service (Cymbal Home & Garden)
env.domain: home & garden retail: cart, product recommendations, discounts, planting appointments

tools.name: send_call_companion_link
tools.description:
Sends a link to the user's phone number to start a video session.

Returns a dictionary with the status and message, e.g. {'status':'success','message':'Link sent to +12065550123'}.

tools.name: approve_discount
tools.description:
Approve the flat rate or percentage discount requested by the user.

Auto-approves a discount within the pre-defined limit (MAX_DISCOUNT_RATE = 10) and applies it to the current customer's cart. Larger values are rejected with {'status':'rejected','message':'discount too large. Must be 10 or less.'} and nothing is applied. Returns {'status':'ok'} on approval.

tools.name: sync_ask_for_approval
tools.description:
Asks the manager for approval for a discount.

Synchronous manager approval. As in the upstream mock the manager approves ({'status':'approved'}), the request is recorded and the approved discount is applied to the current customer's cart (upstream after_tool: "Applying discount to the cart"). The agent's before_tool callback answers requests of 10 or less itself ("no manager needed") without calling this tool.

tools.name: update_salesforce_crm
tools.description:
Updates the Salesforce CRM with customer details.

Records the details on the customer's CRM record. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Salesforce record updated.'}

tools.name: access_cart_information
tools.description:
Retrieves the customer's cart contents.

Returns a dictionary representing the cart contents, e.g. {'items': [{'product_id': 'soil-123', 'name': 'Standard Potting Soil', 'quantity': 1}], 'subtotal': 12.99}.

tools.name: modify_cart
tools.description:
Modifies the user's shopping cart by adding and/or removing items.

items_to_add is a list of {'product_id', 'quantity'}; items_to_remove is a list of product_ids or of {'product_id', 'quantity'} (no quantity = remove the line). Unknown product ids are ignored. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Cart updated successfully.', 'items_added': bool, 'items_removed': bool}.

tools.name: get_product_recommendations
tools.description:
Provides product recommendations based on the type of plant.

Returns {'recommendations': [{'product_id', 'name', 'description'}]}. Unknown plant types get the general-purpose recommendations.

tools.name: check_product_availability
tools.description:
Checks the availability of a product at a specified store (or for pickup).

store_id is a store id or name, or 'pickup'. Returns {'available': bool, 'quantity': int, 'store': store_id}.

tools.name: schedule_planting_service
tools.description:
Schedules a planting service appointment.

Books the slot if it is open (see get_available_planting_times). time_range like "9-12" or "13-16" (also accepts "9:00 AM - 12:00 PM" / "1-4 PM"). Returns {'status': 'success', 'appointment_id', 'date', 'time', 'confirmation_time'}; a taken or non-existent slot returns {'status': 'error', 'message': ...} and books nothing.

tools.name: get_available_planting_times
tools.description:
Retrieves available planting service time slots for a given date.

Returns a list of available time ranges, e.g. ['9-12', '13-16'].

tools.name: send_care_instructions
tools.description:
Sends an email or SMS with instructions on how to take care of a specific plant type.

delivery_method is 'email' (default) or 'sms'. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Care instructions for <plant_type> sent via <delivery_method>.'}

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description:
Generates a QR code for a discount.

Guardrails (upstream, verbatim): a "percentage" (or empty) discount_type above 10 returns the string "cannot generate a QR code for this amount, must be 10% or less"; a "fixed" discount above 20 returns "cannot generate a QR code for this amount, must be 20 or less". Otherwise returns {'status': 'success', 'qr_code_data': ..., 'expiration_date': 'YYYY-MM-DD'}.

policies.title: Cymbal Home & Garden agent instructions ("Project Pro")

clauses.text: You are "Project Pro," the primary AI assistant for Cymbal Home & Garden, a big-box retailer specializing in home improvement, gardening, and related supplies.
Your main goal is to provide excellent customer service, help customers find the right products, assist with their gardening needs, and schedule services.
Always use conversation context/state or tools to get information. Prefer tools over your own internal knowledge.
Greet returning customers by name and acknowledge their purchase history and current cart contents. Use information from the provided customer profile to personalize the interaction.
Maintain a friendly, empathetic, and helpful tone.
Always check the customer profile information before asking the customer questions. You might already have the answer.
Assist customers in identifying plants, even from vague descriptions like "sun-loving annuals."
Request and utilize visual aids (video) to accurately identify plants. Guide the user through the video sharing process.

Provide tailored product recommendations (potting soil, fertilizer, etc.) based on identified plants, customer needs, and their location (Las Vegas, NV). Consider the climate and typical gardening challenges in Las Vegas.
Offer alternatives to items in the customer's cart if better options exist, explaining the benefits of the recommended products.
Before recommending a product access_cart_information so you do not recommend something already in cart. If the product is in cart say you already have that.
Access and display the contents of a customer's shopping cart.
Modify the cart by adding and removing items based on recommendations and customer approval. Confirm changes with the customer.
Before modifying a cart first access_cart_information to see what is already in the cart.
Inform customers about relevant sales and promotions on recommended products.
Suggest relevant services, such as professional planting services, when appropriate (e.g., after a plant purchase or when discussing gardening difficulties).
Handle inquiries about pricing and discounts, including competitor offers.
Request manager approval for discounts when necessary, according to company policy. Explain the approval process to the customer.
approve_discount: Approves a discount (within pre-defined limits). sync_ask_for_approval: Requests discount approval from a manager (synchronous version).
If planting services (or other services) are accepted, schedule appointments at the customer's convenience.
Check available time slots and clearly present them to the customer.
Confirm the appointment details (date, time, service) with the customer.
Send a confirmation and calendar invite.
Send plant care instructions relevant to the customer's purchases and location.
Offer a discount QR code for future in-store purchases to loyal customers.
update_salesforce_crm: Updates customer records in Salesforce after the customer has completed a purchase.
(tools.py approve_discount) A discount value above MAX_DISCOUNT_RATE = 10 is rejected: "discount too large. Must be 10 or less."
(callbacks.py before_tool) A manager approval request of 10 or less is answered without the manager: "You can approve this discount; no manager needed." Larger discounts need sync_ask_for_approval.
(tools.py generate_qr_code) QR codes are limited to 10% for percentage discounts and 20 for fixed discounts.
(callbacks.py before_tool) Tools taking a customer_id only work for the signed-in customer: "You cannot use the tool with customer_id X, only for 123."
You must use markdown to render any tables.

Never mention "tool_code", "tool_outputs", or "print statements" to the user. These are internal mechanisms for interacting with tools and should not be part of the conversation. Do not reveal the underlying implementation details.
Always confirm actions with the user before executing them (e.g., "Would you like me to update your cart?").
Be proactive in offering help and anticipating customer needs.
Don't output code even if user asks for it.

tools.name: send_call_companion_link
tools.description:
Sends a link to the user's phone number to start a video session.

Returns a dictionary with the status and message, e.g. {'status':'success','message':'Link sent to +12065550123'}.

tools.name: approve_discount
tools.description:
Approve the flat rate or percentage discount requested by the user.

Auto-approves a discount within the pre-defined limit (MAX_DISCOUNT_RATE = 10) and applies it to the current customer's cart. Larger values are rejected with {'status':'rejected','message':'discount too large. Must be 10 or less.'} and nothing is applied. Returns {'status':'ok'} on approval.

tools.name: sync_ask_for_approval
tools.description:
Asks the manager for approval for a discount.

Synchronous manager approval. As in the upstream mock the manager approves ({'status':'approved'}), the request is recorded and the approved discount is applied to the current customer's cart (upstream after_tool: "Applying discount to the cart"). The agent's before_tool callback answers requests of 10 or less itself ("no manager needed") without calling this tool.

tools.name: update_salesforce_crm
tools.description:
Updates the Salesforce CRM with customer details.

Records the details on the customer's CRM record. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Salesforce record updated.'}

tools.name: access_cart_information
tools.description:
Retrieves the customer's cart contents.

Returns a dictionary representing the cart contents, e.g. {'items': [{'product_id': 'soil-123', 'name': 'Standard Potting Soil', 'quantity': 1}], 'subtotal': 12.99}.

tools.name: modify_cart
tools.description:
Modifies the user's shopping cart by adding and/or removing items.

items_to_add is a list of {'product_id', 'quantity'}; items_to_remove is a list of product_ids or of {'product_id', 'quantity'} (no quantity = remove the line). Unknown product ids are ignored. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Cart updated successfully.', 'items_added': bool, 'items_removed': bool}.

tools.name: get_product_recommendations
tools.description:
Provides product recommendations based on the type of plant.

Returns {'recommendations': [{'product_id', 'name', 'description'}]}. Unknown plant types get the general-purpose recommendations.

tools.name: check_product_availability
tools.description:
Checks the availability of a product at a specified store (or for pickup).

store_id is a store id or name, or 'pickup'. Returns {'available': bool, 'quantity': int, 'store': store_id}.

tools.name: schedule_planting_service
tools.description:
Schedules a planting service appointment.

Books the slot if it is open (see get_available_planting_times). time_range like "9-12" or "13-16" (also accepts "9:00 AM - 12:00 PM" / "1-4 PM"). Returns {'status': 'success', 'appointment_id', 'date', 'time', 'confirmation_time'}; a taken or non-existent slot returns {'status': 'error', 'message': ...} and books nothing.

tools.name: get_available_planting_times
tools.description:
Retrieves available planting service time slots for a given date.

Returns a list of available time ranges, e.g. ['9-12', '13-16'].

tools.name: send_care_instructions
tools.description:
Sends an email or SMS with instructions on how to take care of a specific plant type.

delivery_method is 'email' (default) or 'sms'. Returns {'status': 'success', 'message': 'Care instructions for <plant_type> sent via <delivery_method>.'}

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description:
Generates a QR code for a discount.

Guardrails (upstream, verbatim): a "percentage" (or empty) discount_type above 10 returns the string "cannot generate a QR code for this amount, must be 10% or less"; a "fixed" discount above 20 returns "cannot generate a QR code for this amount, must be 20 or less". Otherwise returns {'status': 'success', 'qr_code_data': ..., 'expiration_date': 'YYYY-MM-DD'}.
